headline: The three Amazon disputes are well specified, but the gold card order uses expedited shipping, which the customer's script never addresses for this $10-fee tier.

issues.summary: gold[4] persists expedited_shipping=true. doc_replacements_001 tells the agent to ask the customer whether they want expedited shipping and to mention the tier fee ($10 for Silver). Unlike tasks 036/037 ('If offered expedited shipping, accept it'), this script says nothing about expedited shipping, so the stored value depends on what the user simulator improvises.
evidence: doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001: "Ask whether they want expedited shipping (advise on possible fees by tier...)" and "Mid-tier (Silver Rewards, ...): $10.00."
task_038 user instructions: section 'Shipping preference for replacement card' covers only the work address; there is no expedited-shipping step (compare task_036/037 step 6)
tools.py order_replacement_credit_card_7291 stores expedited_shipping in credit_card_orders[order_id]
issues.why_it_matters: If the user simulator declines the $10 fee or does not answer, or the agent defaults to standard, the order record differs from gold and the DB hash fails, even though the agent did nothing wrong.
issues.suggested_fix: Add the step from tasks 036/037 to the user script: 'If offered expedited shipping, accept it.'

solution_check: There are five Amazon charges on the Silver card. The user confirms three: txn_e45e7acb56a0 ($89.99, 10/05) fraud, merchant not contacted, eligible=true (first filed, fraud is exempt from merchant contact); txn_28cb62125078 ($124.50, 10/08) goods_services_not_as_described, contacted, not eligible by reason; txn_2017c3b2b119 ($89.99, 10/10) duplicate_charge, merchant not contacted, so not eligible under doc_015 criterion 5 ('For non-fraud disputes... the customer must have attempted to resolve with the merchant first'). All use cancel_and_reissue, last-4 5320, full_refund, noticed 11/14/2025. These match gold[6..8]. The replacement order matches gold[4] except for the unscripted expedited flag.
prior_note: The prior review rated this task clean. The dispute flags check out; the new finding is the unscripted expedited-shipping choice.
notes: The task notes call the 10/10 duplicate 'eligible', but the gold correctly marks it false (merchant not contacted). The notes are wrong, the gold is right. The 10/10 charge could arguably be classed as fraud (the user says 'clearly their system error or fraud'), which would flip eligibility, but doc_014 says to have the user pick the reason and the script frames it as a DUPLICATE, so I left it in notes. The customer is not given her account id for get_card_last_4_digits; the agent can supply it.
